metadata.description: One plugin for the oh-my-pi token economy: cache-safe tool-result reduction, DeepSeek prefix-cache accounting, and the DeepSeek account balance — one command, one settings menu, one status row.

plugins.name: omp-token-mega
plugins.description: Merged token plugin for oh-my-pi. Reduces live tool results before they are sent (terminal escapes, identical line runs, over-long lines, pretty-printed JSON), collapses byte-identical results by content hash, elides over-budget results behind artifact:// handles, audits the request envelope with copy-paste omp config advice, accounts the DeepSeek prefix cache (hit rate, miss attribution, tool-catalogue drift, subagent shards), reports the DeepSeek account balance and session spend, and registers the LithosAI provider with its /login flow, measured tokens/second and per-minute rate-limit budgets. Every metric is drawn on ONE status row. Never rewrites history, so DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic prefix caches keep their hits.
